tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal sa skya'i gong ma rdo rje 'chang yab sras dang ngor khang gsar mkhan chen dang karma zhwa nag pa bcas la rang gzhan gyi legs 'bul stob pa'i shis brjod tshangs sras rgyud mangs sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rasalenopanāhadait+yonin+debhidza.adzit+yaḥrathasāras+thināgṛhas+thāṃsarbasmin+naneyā/ gamabodhorabiḥkumāraṃdharmāny+pash+yamatraibhabashan+tonipal+labodzīban+takṛdz+dzayan+tu//

༄༅// bcud len gyis 'khon sbyin skyes dmod pas tshugs pa med// shing rta kha los khyim gnas kun du bkri min pa// lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma gzhon nu mthong tsam gyis// srid zhi'i rgud pa 'tsho mthar byed pa rgyal gyur cig /༄༅// drisaṃghārnapapraṇidhiḥparbatāman+thadz+dzātaḥgatesh+shāraṇāgradayaṃdzñas+thamāṇāṃshītaṃshwā/ trayāṇāṃpaṭor+ṇayasūdhāṃshulak+ṣādohīkaḥ muniḥshāsaneshwaradzāṭagratiṣ+ṭhan+tuṇ-it+yaṃ// ༄༅// tshogs zung chu gter smon lam ri bos bsrubs las skyes// 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bsil zer can// mkhas tshul gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i 'od zer 'bum 'jo ba// thub bstan dbang phyug ral rtser rtag par brtan gyur cig /lha rigs 'jam dbyangs skye ba rgyun chags ma byon pa// 'jig rten dam pa'i snying pos dben gyur dogs pa yi// bzlas brjod tsam las thabs gzhan gyis rdugs gang gi tshe// dkon mchog thugs rjes 'gro ba'i re ba 'gengs pa byung*// mi mthun rgud pa ming gi yi ge'i lhag mar byas// mngon par 'dod pa'i snye ma ci yang rtag 'jo ba'i// khor yug 'od kyis snang byed yid bzhin nor bu dag /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i dpyid du legs thob skal ba bzang*// rab byung bgrang gzhi mkha' ro'i dkyil 'khor che rnams las// yon tan zla ba dag byed gos kyis nyer bklubs pa'i// sgra dbyangs brgya pa'i gnam lor legs shar nang gsel gyi// zhag gi phung po gza' skar dus tshes dge ba'i nyin// thub dbang gnyis pa lta bu'i skyes mchog rim byon gyis// bka' lung dgongs 'grel mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i lam yangs nas// ches gsal byed pa'i gdan sa dpal ldan sa skya zhes// longs sku'i zhing bkod sa la 'phos snyam byed pa 'dir// yid 'phrog gser gyi pa tra 'khyug pa'i gar mkhan ma'i// lag pa stong gis sna tshogs nor bu dam 'khyud pas// kun nas sgeg pa'i 'od 'bar ngo mtshar bzo bkod 'dis// bi shwa karma'i 'phrul yang phra mor byed kyis dogs// mi 'gyur chos kyi rkang stegs sku li shas mtshan par// dge mtshan re khā ma bris bkrag tu che ba'i sku// gzhan gyis ma bkur rigs rus mchog gi che ba gang*// ma bteg lha mi'i gtsug na mtho ba lham me ba// skyes sbyangs stobs kyis phyi nang gtsug lag rig pa'i gzhung*// mtha' dag mgrin las 'jo ba 'jam dpal gzhon nu'am// de nyid mi yi srid par brdzus pa gang yin zhes// mang du thos pa'i blo yang 'phyang mo nyug la brten// gang tshe ye shes rdzu 'phrul shing rta skad cig mas// nam mkhar lhags pa'i yid srubs thul gyi dbang po drug

/snying rje che brgyad bgegs dgra phyogs mnyam de dag kyang*// zur gyis blta sogs sgyu rtsal spyod ma lhan cig nyid// 'di na phung po dbyings bcas mi mchog drug byin brlabs// de dag rang rang rtag tu 'os pa'i mnga' dbul dang*// dam tshig gsum mchog rdzogs par dbang bskur khams gsum du// chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab chen por mnga' gsol mdzad// slar yang 'gro 'dul skye ba blangs pa mched kyi sku// bskal par 'tsho zhing gzhes pa tshe mtha' yas pa yi// phyag gi ka la sha las bab pa'i zil mngar gyis// mngon par gtams pa'i bkra shis bum pa bzang po dang*// sems nyid kun gyi gzhir gyur yu ba bskyed bsrings rtser// rnam par byang phyogs chos kyi rtsibs ma stong bkram par// tshad med thugs rje'i dar dkar gyis bkab drwa ba can// skal bzang tsha ba'i gdung ba skyob par byed pa'i gdugs// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung 'tshob skye ba lu gu rgyud// bde ba'i 'byung gnas bsod nams las bzang lhan cig nyid// mig mang ris su mu mtha' med par 'khyil ba las// nyi gzhon 'od la co 'drir bzod pa'i dpal be'u// gzhan phan snying stobs rab tu brtan pa'i srog shing la// sems can mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i dar gos kyi// lhab lhub brtsegs par yid bzhin nor bu'i tog bkod pas// srid zhi'i dgos 'dod char du bsnyil ba'i rgyal mtshan che// bla med byang chub snying po'i lte ba mngon mtho yang*// sngon gyi smon lam bzang spyod 'dab stong yangs par bye// sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston phyogs bral gyi// gdul bya'i bung bar mi zad 'jo ba'i pad+ma dkar// sde bzhi'i 'byor pa'i yo byad rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas// gzhan phan dus las yol ba med pa'i rlabs phreng can// rdzu 'phrul dpag yas lus kyi nyams 'gyur stong phrag gis// rang dbang bsgyur la mig mi 'dzums pa gser gyi nya// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo yis// stong gsum srid pa'i snod bcud ma lus dbang bsdus nas// nga yir bgyid cing 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i 'od// rab tu 'bar ba rtsibs stong tsakra rin po che// theg gsum rgyud bzhi'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs ldir ba'i khongs// 'gro khams las nyon sgrib pa'i rims nad ring bcil nas// thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsos gyur a mṛ ta'i// mgron du gnyer byed bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dung*// che mchog dbang bcu ldan pa rnams kyi yon tan dang*// bkra shis rdzas las brtsams pa'i snyan dngags shis brjod dag

/bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon mchog zung mi 'gyur chos kyi khrir// gsang gsum mi shigs rdo rjer sgrub pa'i thabs su 'bul// e waṃ chos ldan bstan pa'i khur blangs mkhan zur bas// dngos su 'byor pa rnam par 'dren pa'i rten gsum dang*// rin chen zung dang stong 'khun yul gyi dar gos rigs// zang zing dpal 'byor 'gro mgyogs bzhon pa gnag phyugs rnams// kho bos nang shes sgyu ma 'phrul pa'i rgyal po khos// rdul brtsegs dbang po nyi zla ri gling na kra'i grong*// gnyid dang bral ba shed bu lto 'gro'i phun tshogs dpal// khor yug lcags kyi ri bos yongs bskor maṇ+ḍa la// dad dga' rgyas pa'i yid kyis dngos po chung ngu yang*// kun gsal bzhin ras khyab par sprul pa'i mchod 'bul rjes// yi rang dges pa'i tshul gyis bsod nams bla nas blar// 'phel bar 'gyur ba mkhas pa'i bgyi bas bzhes par 'tshal// rnam dkar dge bas thos na dad pa'i sdong po bskyed// bsams na phyi nang yon tan yal 'dab phyogs su rgyas// bsgoms na yang dag rtogs pa'i snye ma g.yur du za// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i dpag bsam bskal par brling gyur cig /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs brjod bya rjod byed dpyad gsum gyi// lam nas legs par 'dren pa'i rgyal po sa skya pa// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i lugs bzang dri ma med// phan bde'i 'byung gnas phyogs dus kun du dar gyur cig /ngag gi dbang phyug gang 'dul gar gyis de dag bstan// 'dzin skyong spel la dpyod ldan kun dga'i blo gros dang*// mtshungs dpe stong gi spyi phud bar du btsal bas kyang*// ma rnyed rang nyid dper 'os gang de zhabs brtan shog /thams cad mkhyen rgyu shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas// bkrag cher snang ba'i ye shes me long rnam pa gnyis// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal thabs chen po'i khri 'phang du// bskal pa'i bar du mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs gyur cig

/nor 'dzin lte ba 'dis mtshon phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*// sgo gsum bag yod la gnas ngur smrig 'chang gi tshogs// chos spyod rnam bcu lhur len 'dus pa'i khur chen la// skrag ste 'od srungs byin lus sra brtan sprul snyam gyur// skyabs kyi dam pa bla ma dkon mchog gtsug tu bkur// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i sprin chen spro ba'i chos rgyal che// mi dpon blon 'khor chab 'bangs skye 'gro thams cad kyi// bsod nams tshe dpal rigs rgyud mnga' thang rgyas gyur cig /lhar bcas skye dgu ma lus pa'i// mthong thos mthar thug bar gyi skyabs// mchog gnyis bstan dang srid pa'i dpal// zung 'jug mnga' gsol chos kyi khrir// shar ba'i rigs skyes mkhan zur pas// shis brjod mnga' gsol smon pa'i lam// rten 'brel khud ba dngos 'byor gyi// rnam grangs bstar pa 'di dag lags// ces khri 'bul gyi yi ge skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rab byung me zla'i bgrang gzhir dpal sa skya'i gdung sras rin po che mched gnyis la/ mkhan chen klu sdings pas legs 'bul btang ba'i tshe/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// wāgishwarānan+dashāsanash+yākaramatrodak+ṣ+yar+hakarmatribhiḥmatiḥtūpabikāshaḥ shāsan+yapālas+yabud+dhashastāyubarādzeshrībhūtakal+yāṇalak+ṣabhadro bidzayan+tu// ༄༅// ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga'i dpal 'byung tshul chen 'dir// blo gros ches gsal mkhas pa la 'os las gsum gyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba'i ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu// dge mtshan dpal gyi 'byung gnas bzang po rgyal gyur cig /rnam drug rgyal ba'i rigs mchog bde bskyed dga' mar bcas// snying rje'i lang tsho dar bab 'phags tshogs mchod byed ma// sdang mig bltas tsam bgegs dgra mthar byed thabs shes dag /kun 'dus gar gyis 'gro ba rdo rje'i sar smin byed// sras bcas rgyal ba'i dgongs don rnam dag nyal 'gro 'bum// rnam dpyod bden smra'i dbugs kyis mkhyen rab gsus par spyil// gzhan dag ma rtogs log brtag bro rigs gzhal ba'i ched// mkhas tshul legs bshad ci 'dod thar pa'i gsos su 'gyed// rgyal ba'i ye shes bsam mi khyab bdag khyod thugs la// lhun gyi grub par rdzogs pa'i mtshar la mi bstod de// che mchog rnams kyi yon tan ma byin blang snyam du// tshur mthong nang shes 'phyang mo nyug la dpyangs kyis dogs// lus can re ba cig car 'gengs 'di nor bu'am// byang chub spyod dgyes mgon po khyod kyi yon tan nyid// dpyad dkar gyur kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur// dngos dang brgyud nas sbyin pas khyod drin kho nar nges// khyab par byas so ma zlum 'od kyis 'jig rten khams// kun phan zer gyis sa dga'i me tog sman gyi tshal// rnam 'dren gdung 'tshob bcas pa'i phrin las dri med rgyun// dad sgrol khyod kyi legs mdzad snang ba mu med kyis// phul byung rtogs brjod phyogs re dran pa'i blo ldan dag

/sngon med dga' ba'i ngo mtshar 'khrungs pa 'di ci zhig /srid zhi'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba nyid// 'gro 'dul skal ba mnyam pa'i gzugs su bstan pa tsam// sku gsum gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid// lha mi gdengs can yul gyi rin chen bem po'i chos// yid 'phrog pa tra'i sgeg mo'i lag pa stong phrag gis// bzung bas bskal pa ji srid 'dogs par bzod dam zhes// lus rtsal yon tan kun nas rdzogs pa'i gdong lnga pa// nga rgyal dregs pa khong nas rgyas pa'i phrag pa dag /lhun po'i spo la co 'drir bzod pa bkra shis grangs// rdo rje'i sa 'dzin bang rim brtsegs par bsgyings pa der// dbyar skyes sdong bu ldem ldem g.yo ba'i dal rten las// yal 'dab khur bu'i dpung pa'i 'dab ma mnyam sbyar nas// ut+pal dkar po'i mgo skyes lang tsho ngom bzhin du// ge sar dgod pa'i tshig sbyor mchod sprin cung zad spro// thams cad mkhyen rgyu phyi nang shes bya'i yul kun la// ma sbyangs med rnams sgrib pa bag chags bcas pas dben// gang phyir srid pa mya ngan las 'das chos ma lus// gsal ler 'char ba ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i gshis// su zhig nyer bsten kun dga' rgyas pa'i grib bsil g.yo// yid 'phrog lo 'dab me tog mañdza ri tshogs dpal// ci 'dod 'jo ba dngos grub zung gi dpag bsam gyi// sa brtol dbang po legs thob 'gro 'di skal ba bzang*// deng dus lung rtogs chos dang ris bral sems can khams// phan 'dogs bde skyid gzhon nu snying gi grogs su 'gugs byas pa'i// thugs rje byin rlabs gzhal du med pa'i khur chen 'di// rdzogs par chud pa'i sa gsum khongs 'di e ma yangs// gsang gsum che ba ming tshig yi ger gyur gang tshe// 'od srungs byin 'dis theg dka'i dogs pa sngun bsu bas// skrag ste rang lus gnam 'phyo'i grong khyer bying gyur pa// biṣ+ṇu khab spu can gyi 'jug pas btegs pa nges// sangs rgyas yon tan 'dzad bral dbyig la dbang 'byor bas// gzugs can gzugs med re ba'i shing rta 'gengs gang la// sngon byas dge ba'i lag pa chung ngu'i bsags pa'i nor// brnab sems dri ma can gyis dgyes pa nam zhig bzod// 'on te 'dab bzang rgyal po rga med zas la dbang bsgyur yang*// res 'ga' gcong rong mtshun zas spyod la rgyu ba bzhin// kho bor gson gshin phyogs nas thob pa'i zang zing brten// rang gzhan tshogs bsags la dgongs gzigs pa'i 'bab stegs mdzod// rnam pa gcig tu nged kyi tsha chung sbrang rtsi'i mgrin// srid zhi'i skyabs mchog yab sras zhabs kyi pad+ma'i rdul// rnam grol thar pa'i bcud du 'thung phyir song ba la'ang*// smin grol gdams pa'i skal ldan nyid du byin gyis rlobs// de'ang 'dir lta byed dbang pos mthong ba don du che ba'i zhal bzang kun phan gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i legs gsol dngos rdzas maṇ+ḍal du sprul nas 'bul ba'i thog mar bkra shis rtags kyi re khās sgeg pa'i dar dkar dkyus su ring ba/

bstan pa'i bdag po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sku brnyan/ gong de'i gsung rab mdo sde bskal pa bzang po/ rdo rje dril bu/ ting shags legs pa dngul thag bcas sogs/ khyon rnam grangs yon tan chu gter zla ba'i grangs mnyam bcas phul ba 'di dag kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi sgrun zlar dmigs pa'i thugs brtse'i dbyings nas dges pa'i tshul gyis bzhes par gsol ba 'debs pa lags so// stobs bcu mnga' ba gaṅgā'i bye ma de snyed grangs// gya nom mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar yon phul ba// rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtso dbyer med rdo rje yi// slob dpon chen por mchod pa'i bsod nams mnyam pa nyid// mdo dang sngags gzhung kun las 'byung don snyigs ma 'dir// ston pa'i mchog nyid 'gro 'dul bla ma'i skur bstan nas// sna tshogs chos kyi snang bas gdul bya dpal stug gi /rgyu lam 'bras bur smin pa'i sku drin dpag yas phyir// dngos 'byor mchod pa 'dis mtshon sgo gsum dge ba'i mthus// 'khor lo'i mgon rnams gzugs sku mi shigs rdo rjer brtan// 'chad rtsam brtsod pa'i phrin las nyi ma'i 'od ltar khyab// 'gro rnams bde skyid de rgyur bcas la spyod gyur cig /bdag cag rigs dpon slob 'khor bcas pa byang chub bar// mi khom brgyad bral dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten thob pa// skyabs mchog zhabs bsten phyi nang gtsug lag kun blo gsal// bstan 'gror phan bde sgrub pa'i byed po nyid byin rlobs// bla ma'i byin rlabs rdzogs ldan sprin ltar char chen 'bebs// yi dam dngos grub bum pa bzang ltar ci 'dod 'jo// bstan srung phrin las rkang mgyogs lta bur gang bcol ba// thogs med 'grub pa'i bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /ces bstan pa'i bdag po dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs drung du/

rang gi tsha bo chos zhur btang ba dang mchod 'bul tshogs bsags kyi maṇ+ḍal stob pa'i ched brjod tshangs sras mgrin pa'i 'gyur khugs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags yos kyi bgrang gzhi'i zla tshes dge bar daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng du bris pa don kun grub par gyur cig/ //

༄༅// dewāgrawāgishwarāshāsanātrasadharmāgamā+ok+taṃgatisādhanoyug pālaṃyawan+niḥsamakarmabhadradzaitāyobaradz+yobidzayan+tushashwataṃ// ༄༅// lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug bstan pa 'dir// lung rtogs dam chos bshad sgrub zung dag gis// ji bzhin skyong la zla bral phrin las bzang*// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rtag par rgyal gyur cig /zab dang rgya che'i tshogs zung chu bo'i gter// sngon gyi smon lam ri bos bsrubs pa'i bcud// rgyal kun 'dus zhal sku yi mi sbyin skyes// tshul chen dri med mkha' dbyings mdzes pa'i rgyan// legs gsungs chos 'dul bstan pa yongs bzung nas// gzhan la spang blang bslab par bya ba'i lung*// nye bar klog pas nges 'byung tshul khrims kyi// sdom pa'i 'byung gnas dgra bcom chen po nyid// gzhan don byang chub mngon 'dod theg chen gyi// rigs su skyes tsam rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob che// mtshungs pa min yang stong nyid snying rje yis// spyod pas khams gsum dbang du bsgyur bas kyang*// gdan gsum lha yi 'khor lo'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// skal ldan 'gro rgyud sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i// rgyu lam 'bras bu dbyer med sbyor ba la// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// sna tshogs 'gro blor 'tsham pa'i yang dag lam// de des re ba 'gengs pa'i yon tan dpe// sangs rgyas yon tan nyid du rnam brtags nas// ma 'dres chos rab dpyod pas rnam par ngal// rgyal ba rgyal tshab bcas pa'i phrin las rgyun// ris bral 'gro la 'doms pa ci zhig mtshar// rang rang skye bar bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams kyi// skal bas thob snyam nga rgyal bskyed kyis dogs// che ba'i ngo mtshar brjod las 'das pa'i mtha'// yongs su ldugs par ma bzod bsam gtan 'dis// rig byed 'byin po gnyid du ma yur mtshang*// mig mi 'dzums pa'i zol gyis bsgribs sam snyam// yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag gang gi zhabs// brtan byed dam pa'i chos kyis mngon mtho bas// legs bris bdag por bcas pa'i skye dgu yis// thor tshugs nor bu'i btud pa ga la bar// dal 'byor rten gyi dbyar skyes sdong bu la// bgrang bzhi lo 'dab mang pos khur lci yang*// mkhas btsun bzang po'i ma zlum 'od dran pas// blo yi 'dab stong grol ba'i bsung 'thul ba// ma bteg dam pa'i chos kyis mtho ba'i khrir// byed pos ma bris 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs// ma bskul las smon bzang pos mnga' gsol ba// 'dris min 'gro la mdza' ba'i spyi mes po// gang tshe mkhas par 'os pa'i las gsum gyi// rtsibs stong tsakras ris bral 'gro ba'i gling*// bdag gir bgyid la yid bsrubs 'tshe ba'i dgras// rnam par dben pa chos smra'i rgyal po che// phul byung mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas tshad// gzhal 'dod kun gsal lus phra'i 'dom pa'i rgya// cher bskyed snang byed zung gi sgron 'degs kyis// bltas pas ma mthong stong pa'i rdzur zhugs snyam// brtse chen snying po'i zhabs dang e waṃ pa// rnam gnyis bka' srol dri med zab rgya che// ji snyed mgrin las 'phos pa'i dbyangs snyan po// thos 'dzin bcud du len la su mi spro// gang phyir rgan bu'i rigs su skyes pa'i dbon// rgyal ba'i myu gus bslab bya brda spros sogs// thos bsam sgor zhugs tsam las sbyangs stobs kyi// kho lag yongs su ma rdzogs na'ang deng*// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i thugs rje'i sprin rum nas// gtan gyi skyabs su 'dod pa'i mig gtod la// dga' spro'i spu sdug ngom pa'i ma yū ra// gom stabs rtsen pa'i sgro gshog bsgyur te song*// skye 'phags 'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs byed pa'i// 'dod dgu kun 'byung dbang gi rgyal po la// zang zing rdzas kyi stob par mi dgyes mod// bsags pa dam pa'i snying po blang ba'i ched// grangs med rgyal ba mchod pa'i bsod nams stobs// rdo rje slob dpon mchod 'bul nyung zad re// phul ba phan yon srang la mnyam pa'i lung*// yid ches maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di ltar lags// 'dir dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i ded dpon// byang chub bar gyi mgon skyabs// gcig pu nyid du gsol ba 'debs pa'i maṇ+ḍal brda mtshon du bkra shis rtags kyi ri mo bkra ba'i stong 'khun yul gyi 'phrul bzos btags pa'i dar dkar dkyus su ring ba/

'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i sgrol ma/ chos tshan pusta ka bka' gdams mchod rten lcags rtse can/ dam tshig rdo rje dril bu/ ting shags legs pa 'dogs thag bcas rnam grangs brgyad cu gya bdun 'di phul ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur dmigs nas brtse bzhes byang chub snying po'i bar du thugs rjes mi gtong bar gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs kyin mchi na ci gnang*/ smras pa/ sngon byon bde gshegs rnams kyi g.yar lam du// mchod rdzas phra mo res kyang byang chub mchog /thugs bskyed smon lam 'bras bu smin pa ltar// bdag kyang mi mchog 'bras bu g.yur za mdzod// de srid skye bar bdag cag ltos 'khor bcas// mi khom brgyad bral dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten// 'dren mchog bla mas rjes bzung phyi nang gi /gtsug lag kun rig mkhas pa'i las byed shog /kho bor chos dang zang zing 'brel thogs mtshon// mar gyur sems can 'khor ba ngan song gi /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral thar pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngos pa don yod mdzod// ces e waṃ chos ldan gyi mkhan po chen po ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po'i zhabs drung du dbon po brdzang pa dang 'bul ba stob pa'i ched brjod ngang pa'i rdza rnga zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rab byung me zla'i nang gsel lcags yos kyi bgrang gzhi'i rgyu skar lha mo chu stod kyi nya ba'i zla tshes la lhun grub steng du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// dzayasarbeṣāṃkarmasid+dhadzñādhātuḥmukuṭenālās+yen+d+ranilas+t+riguh+yā/ kaṣayādhṛg+māyādhayobaikṛḍit+yaḥbidzayan+tuskan+dhoguṇebipraṇītaḥ ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi bya grub ye shes khams// gang 'tsham sgyu 'phrul rnam rol ngur smrig 'chang*// mthon mthing cod paṇa gyis spud gsang ba gsum// gya nom yon tan phung po rgyal gyur cig /bgrang yas skye ba'i sbyangs stobs 'phrul bzo yi// sug bstar mkhyen rab kun mthong dag pa'i ngos// phyi nang gtsug lag mtshar sdug bzhin ras 'bum// bkrag cher snang ba dpyod ldan 'dren byed dpyid// brtse dang byang chub sems la goms pa rnams// bdag don ched gnyer zhen pa ring du spangs// gang phyir yid can phan pa lhun grub tu// rtag par 'jo ba thugs rje che ldan gshis// drang srong ngag gi mtshon cha blangs pa med// yid srubs 'phrul gyi nus pa brkus min pa// skye 'gro sdug bsngal gnas las skad cig nyid// gdon pa'i mthu stobs che 'di gang las byung*// 'gro blo'i mos pa tha dad de dang des// re ba phyur bur 'gengs la mi bsngags te// 'gro 'dul dgongs bzhin skye ba blangs rnams kyi// yon tan ci 'dod 'jo las gzhan ci zhig

/lhun grub rgyun chags mdzad pa 'byams klas pa'i// pha rol blta 'dod dri khyer dga' ma'i lus// myur 'gro'i brdzu la zhugs kyang ma snyed par// ngal brgyas mnar bas shugs ring 'byin nam snyam// sngon bsags bsod nams tshangs pa'i mdzub rtse yis// bris pa'i dge mtshan rnam par bkra ba'i zhabs// bskal par brling ba'i cho ga ma rdzogs na// rung ba min nam sna tshogs las pa des// nyams 'gyur pa tra glog gi rtse dga' mas// dam du 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs nor bu yi// khur ldan bkod legs bskrun pa'i rkang stegs ni// mi 'gyur rdo rjes mtshan pa ga la bar// sa bdag sā la'i rkang 'thung mtshar dngar ba'i// rigs kyi skye ba'i sdong bu bzung ba bdag /dad gus lag pa'i lcug phreng zung sbyar te// 'dzum zer me tog dgod pas 'di skad gsol// ri mor ma bris mtshan bzang rnam par bkra// ma bteg lha mi'i gtsug na mngon mtho ba// 'dris min 'gro ba yongs la mdza' ba'i bshes// ma brdal thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa gang*// lam gsum rgyun 'bab sgrib gnyis sbyong nus min// snang gter zung gi bgrod pa byams brtses dben// skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs kyis gang bcags pa// yon tan de dag gis ni khyad par 'phags// bye brag sde bzhi'i dpal dang dge ba bcu'i// phrin las 'khor lo sngon 'gro'i sa gzhi skyong*// rim pas bsrungs pa'i ljongs kyi thig le 'dir// ye shes gzigs pa dam pa'i 'jug stegs byas// dad gsum nor ldan kho bo gnyen 'khor bcas// lhag pa'i lha mchog mang po'i gsang gsum gyi// rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgrubs te yid srubs thul// mchog gi 'bras bu'i bar du 'bral med bcings// 'jig rten byed pos srang la stong spyi phud// gzhal byar song ba gang zhig mgon khyod kyi// sku gsung thugs drin bcal du btub pa'i tshad// mtshungs las gzhan pa'i sgrun zla med snyam bgyis// 'on te thugs rje yangs pa'i brgya stong gi

/cha shas gsob phyir dngos 'byor dga' tshal las// dad spro'i lag pas btus pa'i 'dab stong gi /sil mas mngon par 'thor ba 'di ltar lags// de'ang tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro 'dul gar gyi dbang phyug chen po nyid/ byams brtse'i sa srungs bu'i theg pa'i kha lo bod chen ljongs zhes/ thub dbang bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar bab kyi phyogs su bsgyur te 'byon pa/ sgos su kho bo cag gi pha mes yang mes kyi chos ldan sa skyong rim byon gyi las shugs btsan pos bsrungs pa la/ slar ma zlum dkyil 'khor 'char phyogs kyi bsod nams gnam gyis bskos pa'i stobs 'khor sgyur ba'i mi bdag gong ma chen po nas/ mdo khams skye 'gro spyi'i bde skyid sgrub thabs shes su bcug pa'i rje bo'i go sar lung las kyi bka' tham chen pos lan gcig min par bkod don ltar/ bstan srid zung 'jug gi phrin las skyong ba sa dbang gi rigs skyes kho bo cag bcas pas legs par bskyangs pa'i yul gru rnams kyi ya gyal dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bod pa 'dir/ byin rlabs 'od rdul 'dzag pa'i zhabs zung pad+mas bkod de/ khor yug yangs pa'i phyogs kyi mdzes dga'i bzhin ras ye shes gzigs pa'i zla snang dkar pos lan brgyar bkrus snyam bgyid cing*/ gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nye zhos dben par phebs pa'i gnang skyes gya nom stsal ba dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu dga' dang dad pa'i nor bu snying gar bcangs pa bdag cag ming lcam blon 'khor du bcas pa la gang 'tsham legs gsungs zab chos kyi bdud rtsi mang pos re ba'i yol go phyur bur bkang ba'i thugs rje che drin rgya mtsho'i zab rgya dpag tu ga la mchis mod/ sku drin gyi 'gram ngogs phyogs de'i tha gru 'jal ba lta bu'i legs gsol gtang rag maṇ+ḍal chabs cig par/ bkra shis re khās mtshan pa'i mdzod dar dkar po sogs/

tshan 'di dag phul ba thugs brtse ba chen pos bzhes nas/ rtag tu mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gur khyim las mi bor bar gsol ba 'debs kyin mchis pa lags so// slar gsol ba/ mi phyed dad pa'i sa gzhi yangs gdal bar// rgyal ba'i rten gsum bkod legs lhun po la// rin chen gos rigs zang zing rta phyugs kyi// ri gling chu gter lcags ris bskor ba 'di// phyogs bcu'i mi mchog yongs kyi thugs rje dang*// byin rlabs thog ma'i smon lam byed po yis// gcig tu bsdus pa yongs 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon// dgyes bskyed maṇ+ḍal sprul te 'bul gyis bzhes// dge bas gus ldan dral lcam ltos 'khor gyis// nyer mtshon chab 'bangs lus can srid do 'tshal// gnas skabs mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing*// mthar thug bsod nams brgya pa'i sku thob shog /ces 'bul yig 'phang 'gro'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje pa sde dge sa skyong chen pos dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu spyan 'dren mdun 'jog stob pa'i ched brjod dgos zhes bka' phebs ltar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder bod pas 'phral du bris pa dge'o// //sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// sgyu 'phrul chu gter snang ba'i nyi ma cher// lung bstan yongs su grags pa'i yang srid gar// theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan skyong la 'dud// mgon khyod gzugs sku spros bral dbyings brtul bar// mi rtog ting 'dzin brgya phrag brnyes gyur kyang*// bdag sogs gdul bya sdug bsngal rgyur bcas la// gyi nar 'phyan pa snying rjes bzod lags grang*// brtse ba'i bdag nyid can rnams gdul dka' yi// mi srun tsher ma'i nags tshal gzings 'dra la'ang*// bung ba pad+ma'i tshal bzhin 'jug spro na// 'gro 'dul sprul sku mi 'byon ci ste bzhugs// khyod sngon skyob pa yongs kyi spyan snga ru// sems can sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral phyir// byang chub spyod gru spyad pa'i g.yar dam la// dgyes dgongs sprul sku la gor 'byon mdzod cig

/rgyal bstan spyi dang pad+ma saṃ bha ba'i// thegaṃ mchoṃg bstanaṃ pa mkhas pa'iṃ tshul gsum gyis// 'dzin skyong spel bar rgyal sras gzhon nu yis// mtshan nyid rdzogs pa skye ba'i gar bsgyur cig /chos dang sems can phan pa'i las 'jug la// mi mthun phyogs gyur ma rig mun bral zhing*// thams cad mkhyen rgyu zab yangs shes bya'i gzhung*// kun shes blo ldan skye ba len mdzod cig /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i mthu rtsal dang*// 'dren mchog khyod kyi thugs bskyed smon lam stobs// bdag gis gsol btab rgyu 'bras bslu med mthus// bsam don dbang gi lcags kyus khugs par shog /ces nyi grags sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
